zh: 右下角的缩放手柄改成贴着卡片圆角的一段弧：静置时不画，悬停时半透明，拖动时完整露出；改变大小时，尺寸读数铺成覆盖整张卡的遮罩。
en: The bottom-right resize handle is now an arc that follows the card's rounded corner — hidden at rest, semi-transparent on hover and fully shown while dragging; while resizing, the size readout becomes a mask over the whole card.
